help.ADULT: Adults see everything and look after the family, the areas and the invites.
help.CHILD: Children see their own notes and whatever is shared with everyone. They can't add events.
help.HELPER: Helpers, like a grandparent or a babysitter, see the week and the shopping list, but nothing that's just for the adults.

list.title: Family
list.helperSub: Sees the week and the shopping list

addChild.hint: Your child gets their own magnet on the door. No account needed - they can have their own login later.
addChild.name: Name

photo.deniedBody: Allow Magneten to access your photos in Settings to add one.

member.notFound: Couldn't find this person on the door.
member.name: Name
member.lastAdult: A home needs at least one adult with an account. Make someone else an adult first.
member.claimHint: Has {{name}} got a phone of their own? Make a code, and once the app is installed {{name}} is linked to their magnet.
member.claimHow: Open the link on {{name}}'s phone, or type the code under "Join". It works once, for seven days.
member.claimShare: Hi {{name}}! Here's your own login for Magneten: {{url}} (code {{code}})
member.removeBody: {{name}}'s notes and areas will be left without an owner. This can't be undone.
member.leaveBody: You won't see this door any more. If you're the last one with an account, the home is deleted with everything in it.

areas.title: Who owns what
areas.kicker: Whoever owns an area thinks about it, plans it and does it
areas.nobody: Nobody owns "{{name}}" yet. Who's taking it?
areas.emptyBody: Split up the things that need thinking about, so no one has to remember it all. Start with a suggestion below.
areas.emptyBodyReadOnly: The adults haven't shared out any areas yet.
areas.name: Name
areas.ownerHelp: The owner keeps track. Anyone can still pick up notes from it.
areas.deleteBody: Its notes stay on the door, just without an area.

invite.title: Invite
invite.adultsOnly: Only adults can invite people to the door.
invite.childHint: Add children from the Family tab. They can get their own login later.
invite.qrA11y: QR code. Scan it with the camera on the other phone.

me.onlyYou: Only you can see this. Magneten never compares you.

reminders.title: Reminders
reminders.sub: In the morning, and before things that are yours

assignments.title: When something's yours
assignments.sub: A note or event for you

me.notifDeniedBody: Turn on notifications for Magneten in Settings so they can reach you.
me.plussOffSub: See what Pluss does for the whole family
me.deleteBody: Your account is deleted for good. Notes you've added stay in the home, without your name.

kid.empty: No notes for you right now, {{name}}.
kid.extraTitle: Want to earn a bit extra?
kid.exitBody: You'll go back to the whole door.

pluss.title: Magneten Pluss
pluss.lead: One person pays, the whole family gets it. Everything you need to get going is free.
pluss.fine: Nothing is charged until the trial ends. One subscription for the whole household. Cancel in the App Store.
pluss.askAdult: Pluss is something the adults sort out. Ask {{names}}.
pluss.adultsOnly: Pluss is something the adults sort out.
pluss.onBody: Everyone in the home has Pluss.
pluss.manage: Change or cancel in the App Store under Subscriptions.
pluss.thanksBody: Pluss switches on for the whole family in a moment.
pluss.restoredBody: If you have an active purchase, Pluss switches on in a moment.
pluss.unavailableBody: The store isn't answering right now. Please try again later.
